description: An envelope follower: it reads the level of a signal and puts out a voltage following it, with its own attack and release, and a scope for watching both

params.text: Scales the incoming signal before its level is read, 0 to 5
Sets the attack, how quickly the envelope rises as the signal grows, 0 to 1
Sets the release, how quickly the envelope falls as the signal dies away, 0 to 1
Shifts the envelope voltage up or down, -5 to +5
Scales the envelope voltage, -5 to +5, turning it upside down at negative settings
Delays the envelope before it leaves the module, 0 to 0.2 seconds
Delays the copy of the input signal before it leaves the module, 0 to 0.2 seconds
Sets the time span the scope draws
Sets the vertical scale of the scope, -2 to +8
Switches the scope display on and off
Sets how much the followed level is smoothed, 1.0 to 0.0

inputs.text: The signal whose level is followed

outputs.text: The envelope followed from the input signal
A copy of the input signal, delayed by DELAY SIGNAL
